name: verify_customer
description: Verifies customer identity using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing any debt details. Must be called before any debt disclosure.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN code or 4-digit birth year provided by the user.

name: log_promise_to_pay
description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount after the customer commits to a payment.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

ptp_date.description: The ISO-8601 date agreed upon for payment, e.g., 2026-08-14

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay, in INR.

name: send_payment_link
description: Sends a payment link via SMS or WhatsApp after a promise-to-pay is logged.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

channel.description: Delivery channel for the payment link.

name: escalate_to_agent
description: Routes the call to a human agent for hardship negotiation or dispute resolution that is outside the bot's authorization.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

name: mark_disposition
description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status in the database. Call this once before the call ends.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

status.description: Final disposition status for the call.

notes.description: Free-text notes providing context for the disposition.
